items.title: Every hyperplane in projective space is isomorphic to projective space of one lower dimension with the twist matched
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma exhibits an isomorphism from projective (n-1)-space onto any hyperplane H in projective n-space carrying O(1) to the restriction of O(1). The proof writes projective n-space as Proj of a polynomial ring, identifies the section defining H with a linear form, uses the description of the zero scheme to see that the homogeneous ideal of H is generated by that form, exhibits the quotient as a polynomial ring in n variables as graded rings, and obtains the isomorphism by functoriality of Proj; the equality of twists is then read off from the corresponding result on surjective graded ring maps generated in degree one (proof lines 6466-6492). H2: the identification of the homogeneous ideal and the graded-ring isomorphism are the substance and are carried out in detail.
